title: 第25章 大日神丹第26章 魔君授首
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
“炼魔？桀桀桀桀……”
黑煞魔君发出一阵刺耳的尖笑，仿佛听到了世间最好笑的笑话。
“无知的人类小辈！
本君乃是不死不灭的魔魂之体！
就算你拥有神火，也最多只能伤到本君，想要炼化本君？简直是痴人说梦！”
“是吗？”
林天不再与他废话。
他知道，对付这种活了不知多少万年的老怪物，任何言语，都是苍白的。
唯有，绝对的、超出他认知范畴的力量，才能让他，真正地，感到恐惧！
“结阵！
拖住他！”
林天一声令下，早已与他心意相通的队员们，瞬间动了！
“吼——！”
熊霸天咆哮一声，庞大的身躯，如同一座移动的战争堡垒，第一个，迎向了那魔气冲天的“陈风”
它那身新生的“鸿蒙龙熊宝甲”
，闪烁着淡淡的紫金色光泽，竟对那无孔不入的魔气，有着极强的克制作用！
“破军！
开山！”
韩立怒喝一声，人剑合一，化作一道璀璨的流光，紧随其后！
他那筑基中期的强大剑意，竟隐隐带着一丝一往无前的霸道，正面硬撼那半步金丹的恐怖威压！

“七幻迷踪阵！”
“五行束缚符！”
“看你朱爷爷的‘佛跳墙’……啊呸，是‘铁锅镇魔’！”
林墨、苏沐沐、朱有福等人，也在瞬间，各司其职！
阵法、符箓、法宝……各种攻击与辅助手段，如同狂风暴雨般，将那刚刚降世的魔君，笼罩其中！
一场堪称惨烈，也堪称悲壮的……“拖延战”
，就此展开！
而林天，则在这片狂暴的战场中心，缓缓地，盘膝而坐。
他，竟真的要在这强敌环伺、生死一线的绝境之中，现场开炉，炼制那枚……决定胜负的逆天神丹！
“疯子！
你这个彻头彻尾的疯子！”
黑煞魔君看着这一幕，气得三尸神暴跳！
他能感觉到，自己竟被……无视了！
“本君要让你知道，在本君的魔域之中，任何挣扎，都是徒劳的！”
content_en:
"Refining demons? Jiejiejiejie..."
The Black Devil Lord let out a harsh laugh, as if he had heard the funniest joke in the world.
"Ignorant junior human!
I am the body of an immortal demon soul!
Even if you have divine fire, you can only hurt me at most. Do you want to refine me? It’s simply a fool’s errand! "
"Really?"
Lin Tian stopped talking nonsense to him.
He knew that any words would be useless to deal with this old monster that had lived for countless thousands of years.
Only absolute power that is beyond his cognitive scope can truly make him feel fear!
"Formation!
Hold him back! "
Lin Tian gave an order, and the team members who had already been in tune with him moved instantly!
"Ho--!"
Xiong Batian roared, and his huge body was like a moving war fortress. The first one faced the demonic "Chen Feng".
Its new "Hongmeng Dragon Bear Armor"
, shining with a faint purple-gold luster, actually has a strong restraint effect on the all-pervasive demonic energy!
“Po Jun!
Open the mountain! "
Han Li shouted angrily, and his sword merged into one, turning into a bright stream of light, followed closely behind!
His powerful sword intention in the middle stage of foundation building actually had a hint of indomitable domineering, and it could withstand the terrifying pressure of the half-step golden elixir head-on!
"Seven Illusions and Lost Formation!"
"Five Elements Binding Talisman!"
"Look at your Grandpa Zhu's 'Buddha Jumps over the Wall'...ah, it's 'Iron Pot to Suppress Demons'!"
Lin Mo, Su Mumu, Zhu Youfu and others also performed their duties in an instant!
Formations, talismans, magic weapons...all kinds of attacks and auxiliary means, like a violent storm, enveloped the newly born Demon Lord!
A brutal and tragic... "delay war"
, unfold here!
Lin Tian, ​​on the other hand, slowly sat cross-legged in the center of this violent battlefield.
He actually wanted to start a furnace on the spot and refine the heaven-defying magic pill... that would determine victory or defeat in this desperate situation where powerful enemies were waiting for him and life and death were on the line!
"Madman!
You complete lunatic! "
The Black Demon Lord looked at this scene and was so angry that the Three Corpse Gods jumped!
He could feel that he was being...ignored!
"I want you to know that in my demonic realm, any struggle is in vain!"
